d: Namaste, I was fortunate enough to recently drive a car that will soon become a symbol of a big celebration unfolding as you read this. Mercedes-Benz is now a 140-year-old brand, and they are celebrating by taking three brand-new 2026 S-Classes to 140 places across the globe. In that process, these cars came to India to be delivered to certain places, and I drove them from Agra to Jaipur. I took this opportunity to narrate one important milestone of the brand for each decade since its inception.
